thread:
samir: Quick heads-up: starting a short access sweep for the payments cluster. We saw intermittent KMS log gaps for the payments keyring and want to gather evidence before any entitlement changes. Noted missing rotation/grant events in the last 72h :warning:
leah.eng: where exactly? missing KMS activity logs or IAM change events?
oscar-sre: alert came in for KMS_INGEST_DELAY affecting eu-west-1. Looks like the logging pipeline dropped some entries between 2026-03-18T07:30Z and 2026-03-18T09:10Z.
samir: my worry is pruning based on incomplete telemetry. jamal, can you snapshot current admin principals and export KMS grants so we have a source-of-truth?
jamal-sec: on it. Ill produce both an IAM snapshot and the key grant export. Storing to secure evidence bucket.
leah.eng: useful commands (for reference):
```bash
# IAM principals with payments-admin role (GCP/AWS fallback)
rg=$(gcloud projects list --format='value(projectId)' | head -1) && gcloud projects get-iam-policy $rg --flatten=bindings --filter='bindings.role:roles/redwood.payments.admin' --format=json || aws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?contains(RoleName, 'payments')]==`[]`"
# KMS grants export (GCP example)
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=europe-west1 --format=json > /tmp/payments-key-iam.json
```
maya-eng: I can also run the internal privilege scanner against the payments namespace to flag broad groups: `tools/priv-audit --namespace payments --format csv`
oscar-sre: pulling logs now to correlate. Command I ran:
```bash
gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName:UpdateCryptoKey" --freshness=96h --format=json > /tmp/kms-update-events.json
```
jamal-sec: snapshot complete. Evidence uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1764002468/snapshot-20260318.json :white_check_mark:
samir: nice. Keep a strict freeze on any entitlement removals until we have the candidate list and the evidence artifact. No adhoc prunes.
leah.eng: proposed next steps:
- oscar to confirm ingestion pipeline delay vs permanently missing records
- jamal + maya to run least-priv run and compile candidate prune list with justification and fallback steps
- schedule a 30m canary prune window with 1h monitoring and rollback path
- attach artifacts to ticket SEC-2026-318 and include the emergency-grant playbook link
oscar-sre: initial root cause looks like a transient log-forwarder restart during a deployment window. Forwarder crashed then restarted; some messages were buffered but not ACKed. I'm investigating why we didn't reingest the backlog.
jamal-sec: on the prune candidates, I'll include a "blast radius" column and quick revert commands for each entry. Also will mark any cross-account grants we can't attribute.
samir: add cross-account grants and partner account keys to the checklist. Those frequently lack owner metadata.
leah.eng: I created SEC-2026-318 and attached the snapshot link plus the playbook: https://rbw-docs/internal/security/emergency-grant.md
auditbot: automated: evidence archived to s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1764002468/ and ticket SEC-2026-318 updated with artifacts.
oscar-sre: filed a subtask for the forwarder: INFRA-8043 (investigate reingest/backfill). Flagged as P2.
maya-eng: running privilege-audit now; will push CSV to the evidence path and add a short rationale column.
jamal-sec: reminder: if we prune and an app fails, we use emergency-grant flow (15min) and record the temporary grant in the ticket with justification.
samir: good call. leah, can you schedule the canary tomorrow 09:30 PT and invite #eng-oncall, #payments, #security, #eng-sre?
leah.eng: scheduled, invite sent. Calendar shows 30m + 1h post-watch.
oscar-sre: once I finish correlating logs Ill post a short summary here and link the INFRA-8043 updates. :eyes:
jamal-sec: least-priv run started. ETA 3h for the candidate list and CSV.
samir: thanks everyone. Keep all artifacts in SEC-2026-318 and do not make any direct entitlement changes outside the scheduled window. Ping me if you find ownerless grants.
